feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. Iteration 9 (wheel_radius 0.025 m, otherwise iteration 8) scored 69.72, below iteration 8's 71.37. Progress fell on all three tracks (oval 0.197 from 0.201, s-bend 0.185 from 0.188, slalom 0.119 from 0.125), while max_error stayed at 0.062-0.063 m and line_loss_events stayed at about 1 on the s-bend and slalom. Lower radius therefore does not fix the control problem and costs progress. Iteration 8 (mass 0.4 kg, radius 0.030 m) is the reference. Depending on the next race: if progress rises above the iteration 8 values on all tracks while max_error stays near 0.062-0.066 m, keep increasing the radius toward 0.038 m. If progress rises but steering_oscillation on the slalom rises above about 0.18 (iteration 8 was 0.168), keep 0.034 m and address damping before adding more speed. If progress falls, return to 0.030 m, since both directions from there have now been tested.
requested_changes: If progress rises on all three tracks at wheel_radius 0.034 m with max_error still near 0.062-0.066 m, try wheel_radius 0.038 m next, citing iteration 8 (oval 0.201, s-bend 0.188, slalom 0.125) and iteration 9, where the smaller radius reduced progress on every track.
If slalom steering_oscillation rises above about 0.18 with the larger radius, keep wheel_radius at 0.034 m and do not increase it further, citing iteration 8 slalom oscillation of 0.168 at 0.030 m.

Keep mass at 0.4 kg, wheel_track at 0.08 m, sensor_size at 0.012 m and the seven-sensor row at y = 0.07 m fixed. Iteration 8 gave the best result with these values, and iterations 6 and 7 showed the 16 mm footprint and wider tracks did not help.
